Book Title: The Scariest Campfire Story You've Ever Heard!: A Spooky Silly Camping Picture Book for Kids (The Scariest Silliest Stories, 2)
Author: Ron Keres, Arthur Lin
Categories (Amazon): Books > Children's Books > Growing Up & Facts of Life > Family Life > Siblings
Summary: Venture into the wilderness with Ron Keres and Arthur Lin as they unravel a hair-raising tale that will keep young readers on the edge of their sleeping bags! Beneath a sky full of stars, two brothers huddle close to their dad, the warm glow of the campfire flickering on their faces. Dad whispers the legend of Bigfoot―a creature said to roam just beyond the ring of light, always listening for the laughter of campers. As the night deepens and mysterious sounds echo from the woods, each  snap ,  crunch , and  crinkle  sparks wild imaginations and the question: what if Bigfoot is real? A great read-aloud for kids ages 3 to 8,  The Scariest Campfire Story You've Ever Heard  transforms ordinary nights into lasting memories with its spooky story and silly twist. Whether it's Halloween, a camping trip, or a cozy evening at home, this follow up to  The Scariest Story You've Ever Heard  is a read-aloud favorite that brings parents, children, and classrooms together around a story that promises both a safe thrill and the silly giggles that last long after the last page is turned.

Book Title: Maddi's Fridge
Author: Lois Brandt, Vin Vogel
Categories (Amazon): Books > Children's Books > Growing Up & Facts of Life > Difficult Discussions > Homelessness & Poverty
Summary: Winner of:  2014 Christopher Award, Books for Young People  2014 ILA Primary Fiction Award  2015 MLA Mitten Award Honor  Human Rights in Children's Literature Honor. With humor and warmth, this children's picture book raises awareness about poverty and hunger.   Best friends Sofia and Maddi live in the same neighborhood, go to the same school, and play in the same park, but while Sofia's fridge at home is full of nutritious food, the fridge at Maddi's house is empty. Sofia learns that Maddi's family doesn't have enough money to fill their fridge and promises Maddi she'll keep this discovery a secret. But because Sofia wants to help her friend, she's faced with a difficult decision: to keep her promise or tell her parents about Maddi's empty fridge.  Filled with colorful artwork, this storybook addresses issues of poverty with honesty and sensitivity while instilling important lessons in friendship, empathy, trust, and helping others. A call to action section, with six effective ways for children to help fight hunger and information on anti-hunger groups, is also included. A portion of the proceeds are donated to help fight childhood hunger.
